swsh12pt5.structure: 10 cards: Commons, 3 Uncommons, 1 reverse holo slot that becomes a Galarian Gallery card about 1 in 3 packs, 1 rare-or-better slot; Radiant Rares replace a Common (about 1 in 22).
swsh12pt5.notes: Rates from Card Codex per-pack table (community-compiled; method not published), p=1/N. Rare-slot default 'Rare' absorbs the remainder. Reverse-slot default draws uniformly from main-set C/U/R/Rare Holo, which matches Card Codex's reverse C/U/R/RH split (card-count proportional). API rarity 'Rare Ultra' lumps full-art V/VMAX, alt arts and full-art trainers together, so alt arts are not separated. Basic Energy is not in the inventory and is omitted. Real pack has 5C/3U; compressed to 2C/2U. Radiant Rares are placed in a Common slot (slot 2) as an independent hit, so a pack can have TG + Radiant + rare-slot hit (some sources say radiants take the reverse slot; we follow the common-replacement reading). Galarian Gallery total is about 34.9% per pack (1 in 2.9), consistent with the commonly cited 1 in 3 to 4. GG 'Rare Holo' cards use API rarity 'Trainer Gallery Rare Holo'. Main-set Rare Secret has 1 card (slot 6 only).

cel25.structure: Celebrations: 4 cards, all holo, no commons/uncommons: ~3 main-set non-V holos + 1 hit slot that is a Classic Collection reprint (~1/2.5), V (~1/2.8), VMAX (~1/13), full-art Professor's Research (~1/25), gold Mew (~1/150), else another main-set holo.
cel25.notes: App needs 6 cards; the most faithful filler is extra main-set non-V holos (the real pack's only 'base' cards), so slots 1-5 are filler and slot 6 is the single hit slot with Card Codex rates (CC 40%, V 35.7%, VMAX 7.7%, Ultra 4%). The API labels main-set non-V cards as 'Rare' (12) or 'Rare Holo' (6, which includes the gold secret Mew cel25-25), so 'Rare Holo' is kept rare (9% in slot 5 + share of slot 6) to hold gold Mew near ~1/60 instead of the real ~1/150; tagging cel25-25 with its own rarity would allow an exact 1/150 rate. Slot 6 default (first) is Classic Collection since it is the most likely outcome. Gold Mew (cel25-25) re-tagged Rare Secret at ~1/150.

swsh45.notes: Card Codex rates: Shiny Rare 1/4.4, Shiny V 1/19.8, Shiny VMAX 1/25.5, SV secret 1/109.9 (slot 5); Holo 1/5.6, V 1/9.2, Amazing 1/17.4, VMAX 1/18.4, Ultra 1/30.8, Rainbow 1/84 (slot 6). Plain Rare takes the remainder (55.7% vs quoted 62.5%; quoted rare-slot figures sum to >100%). Amazing Rares kept in the rare slot.

sm115.structure: Hidden Fates: 10 cards = 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 reverse-holo slot that is replaced by a Shiny Vault card ~39% of packs, 1 rare slot (Rare / Holo / GX / full art / rainbow).
sm115.notes: Shiny Vault rates from cardzard.com 2,350-pack sample (via Elite Fourum guide): baby shinies 1/4, Shiny GX 1/9, SV full-art trainers 1/73, gold 1/57, all in slot 5. Main-set rare slot is partly estimated: ~40% premium (forum model 14.4/36) split GX 28%, full art 8%, rainbow 3%; Rare Holo 18%, plain Rare remainder. Default first outcome of slot 5 is a main-set reverse; Shiny Rare is not the most likely outcome so it is not first.

neo1.structure: Neo Genesis (unlimited): 11 cards = 6 commons, 1 basic energy, 3 uncommons, 1 rare (holo ~1 in 3).
neo1.notes: Energy+commons (7) : uncommons (3) compressed like Base Set; energy (rarity '') 50% of slot 1 ~= the real 1 energy per 11 cards scaled to 6. Falls back to Common if energies are absent from the catalog.

base5.structure: Team Rocket (unlimited): 11 cards = 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare; holo ~1 in 3; Dark Raichu (83/82 secret) replaces the holo very rarely.
base5.notes: Holo 1/3 is standard WOTC; Dark Raichu rate has no published figure - estimated 1 in 100 packs (taken out of the holo share). Team Rocket packs contained no basic energy in the inventory.

base3.structure: Unlimited Fossil: 11 cards = 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare (holo ~1 in 3). No energy.
base3.notes: Same compression as Base Set. 15 holos / 15 rares in inventory.

base2.structure: Unlimited Jungle: 11 cards = 7 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare (holo ~1 in 3). No energy in Jungle packs.
base2.notes: Same compression as Base Set, no energy.

base1.structure: Unlimited Base Set: 11 cards = 7 commons (energy printed on the common sheet), 3 uncommons, 1 rare; the rare is holo ~1 in 3 packs, otherwise non-holo. Exactly one rare per pack.
base1.notes: 7C:3U compressed to 3.5C:1.5U (slots 1-3 Common, 4 Uncommon, 5 50/50). Basic energy (rarity '') is 50% of slot 1 (~0.5 energy/pack; real packs had ~1-2 energies among the 7 commons). If energies are not in the catalog the slot falls back to Common. Only slot 6 can give Rare/Rare Holo, so exactly 1 rare and never 2 holos.
